site.title: Web Developer
site.tagline: Clear, accessible WordPress and React websites for the people who use them.

about.lead: I build and look after websites that people can actually use.
about.body: Three years of WordPress and front-end work across a membership charity, a B2B music platform and small-business clients. I care about plain content, consistent navigation and WCAG-compliant pages, and I'm comfortable working between content owners, agencies and developers. Based in Greater London.

caseStudies.title: Broadcast collections platform
caseStudies.summary: Researchers and students at UK universities needed to find specific TV and radio programmes quickly and trust what they found. I moved the collections onto a new platform and rebuilt the pages they search and browse.
points: Migrated collections including TRILT, Channel 4 Press Packs, Independent Radio and News on Screen.
Rebuilt search forms, record views and audio players to be responsive and WCAG-compliant.
Built WordPress REST API endpoints so the legacy app could share the main site's header, footer and menus.

caseStudies.title: WordPress components and website redesign
caseStudies.summary: A membership charity's main website, used by higher-education members and the public. When an external agency rebuilt it, I worked between the agency, our content team and our tech lead.
points: Built reusable components editors could drop into pages: hero, tiles, cards, accordion, tabs and video player.
Integrated Advanced Custom Fields, MailerLite sign-ups, Google Tag Manager and cookie consent.
Built the Your Local Arena microsite for an Arts Council England-funded project featuring the BBC Arena film archive.

caseStudies.title: B2B marketing website
caseStudies.summary: A music catalogue platform serving broadcast, entertainment and education. I managed and extended the live WordPress marketing site, then built the new site for the platform relaunch.
points: Extended the site with custom templates and fields (Elementor, Gravity Forms, ACF), enquiry forms to email and LinkedIn tracking.
Restored the live site within an hour after a plugin update needed a newer PHP version, working with our DevOps engineer.
Designed and built the relaunch site from requirements agreed with client services. It has not launched yet, so it is described here rather than shown.

caseStudies.title: Small-business websites
caseStudies.summary: Marketing websites for small-business clients, including Symba Marketing, taken from requirements to launch on WordPress, Wix and GoDaddy.
points: Planned page structure and navigation with each client before building.
Trained clients after launch so they could update their own content with confidence.
